purpose: Teach: 辻/ぃ/にゃ/かぁ/るる/之/燭/頁

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「辻角の和菓子屋さんが美味しい」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me that the traditional sweet shop at Tsujisumi makes the most delicious sweets.
lines.style: Warm, informative tone. Natural cadence of a mother sharing something she's just learned. Slight lift at the end—pleased to pass it along. Unstudied and genuine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「なんだぃ?」って声を掛けられたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad called out to me with something—'what's up?'—in that funny way of his.
lines.style: Small, amused observation. Matter-of-fact delivery with a thread of quiet humor running underneath. No performance, just reporting what happened. Slight wonder in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが猫さんに「にゃあ」って真似されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was mimicking the cat—'meow, meow'—and the cat actually did it back to him.
lines.style: Soft, playful tone with gentle amusement. The cadence of someone who found the whole thing endearing. Warm without being oversold. Slight smile audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「そっかぁ、頑張ったね」って褒めて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad praised me—said 'you really did your best'—and I felt so happy.
lines.style: Quiet pride and warmth. The voice of a child who received exactly the kind of praise he needed. Not loud, but solid. A small, genuine happiness underneath the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが寝かしつけに「ねるるねるる」って優しく仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was getting you ready for bed and kept saying that soft, sleepy thing—'neru-ru, neru-ru'—so gently.
lines.style: Very soft, almost whispered. The tone of someone recalling a tender bedtime moment with affection. Slow pace, warm. Trailing slightly, as if remembering the peacefulness of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに古い書道で「之」の書き方を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me the old way to write the character for 'of'—showed me the proper brushstrokes and everything.
lines.style: Earnest, attentive tone. The quiet pride of learning something deliberate and specific. Respectful of the instruction received. Steady delivery, no hurry.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが法事の燭台、つまり燭を新しくされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad changed the candles in the memorial altar—the old ones, he replaced them all with new ones.
lines.style: Gentle, composed tone. Speaking of a quiet, dutiful act with understated respect. Steady pace. The voice of someone noting something meaningful without making ceremony of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに本の十頁から読みなさいって教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to start reading from page ten—taught me where to begin and helped me find it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, earnest tone. The voice of a child reporting clear instruction that made sense. Careful, attentive. Not rushed. A hint of quiet satisfaction in following direction well.
